title: Retire in 10 Years or Less: Unlock Your Passive Income Machine® and Secure Tax-Free Income
description: What if retirement wasn’t about saving harder—but finally learning to play the money game the right way? Are you working harder, saving more, and still wondering if you’ll ever retire? Here’s the hard truth: the traditional retirement plan is broken. Wall Street wants you to work for 40 years, hand them your money, and hope it lasts. That system was never designed to set you free—it was designed to keep you trapped. In Retire in 10 Years or Less , Ryan D. Lee—financial strategist and founder of Wealth Outside Wall Street—teams up with Robert G. Allen, #1 New York Times bestselling author of Nothing Down and Creating Wealth , to reveal a proven framework for achieving financial freedom in a single decade. With a foreword by Robert T. Kiyosaki, legendary author of Rich Dad Poor Dad , the #1 personal finance book of all time, this book continues the mission of showing people how to escape the rat race and live free. You’ll learn: Why Wall Street’s “accumulation and distribution” model fails—and how to escape it. How to unlock the Passive Income Machine® to build tax-free income that lasts for life. How to multiply your results with the same principles banks and the wealthy use every day. Why cash flow—not net worth—is the only true measure of freedom. How to create a personalized Game Plan that works—whether you’re in your 30s, 40s, or starting late in life. Before you finish this book, you’ll experience a complete shift in how you see money, wealth, and retirement. You’ll realize you’ve been playing by the wrong rules—and you’ll finally know how to win. If you’re content to work until you’re 70 and hope you don’t run out of money, this book isn’t for you. But if you’re ready to rise up, live free, and retire in 10 years or less— this is your playbook .  if(window.mix_csa)
